## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Reference the approved backlog item or existing issue when applicable.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results, including relevant acceptance criteria. Explain any checks that could not be completed. For service endpoint changes, identify the unit and request-level tests added or updated and the CI check that runs them.

## Interface or deployment impact

Describe any API/event changes, migrations, or configuration changes. Remove this section when not applicable.
